name: Union Furniture Manufacturing Company
old_description: Union Furniture Mfg. Inc was founded and started by Ruley Sutton in 1959. After 50 years Mr. Sutton and his two sons Dewayne Sutton & Jeff Sutton continue to manage the everyday operations.
about:
Union Furniture Manufacturing Company has operated from Fort Smith, Arkansas since 1959, when Ruley Sutton founded the business. More than six decades later, the company remains family-run: Sutton and his two sons, Dewayne and Jeff Sutton, oversee daily operations.

The shop produces upholstered living-room furniture—sofas, love seats, chairs, ottomans, and sectionals—in rustic, contemporary, traditional, and transitional styles. A crew of 11 to 15 skilled employees builds frames, installs springs, and applies a rotating selection of fabrics and textiles. The company does not disclose facility square footage or annual volume, but it emphasizes a made-to-order approach for its dealer network.

Union Furniture sells exclusively to furniture dealers, serving both large regional chains and small family-owned retailers. It does not offer direct-to-consumer sales.

The founding goal was to deliver high-quality upholstered furniture at a fair price while keeping fabric selections current. The company backs its frames and springs with a lifetime warranty for the original purchaser, a guarantee it describes as one of the best in the business.
